text:
daria: Heads-up from HW partner call: they want a combined observability pack for marketplace that includes Datadog dashboards, OTLP example configs, and an SI playbook. How much can we ship with minimal engineering touch?
kevin: We can assemble a curated bundle: exporter snippet, mapping rules, 3 dashboard widgets, and a short runbook. Engineering involvement needed for validation only.
rana: We should include recommended sampling, batching, and compression settings for OTLP exporters to control ingestion cost. Suggest defaults: batch_size=512, batch_timeout_ms=200, compression=gzip, resource.attributes include device.serial and model.name.
daria: Good. Legal note?
legal-bot: Reminder: partner co-branding requires completed MSA and logo approval. Public listing requires partner sign-off on marketplace tile copy. Allow 10 business days for review.
ops-bot: Checklist seeded: [x] minimal attr list, [x] sampling recommendations, [ ] validated exporter snippet, [ ] dashboard JSON, [ ] SI playbook, [ ] PR for map rules.
kevin: I'll prototype the exporter snippet and run a quick ingest test in staging. Expect PR by Thu.
rana: Also propose a compact DD dashboard with: top-5 models by p95 latency, partition-level memory headroom, and a trace sample explorer. Keep queries lightweight.
daria: Can we provide a telemetry cost estimate template? HW buyers always ask.
kevin: I'll attach a simple spreadsheet template with inputs: qps, metrics_per_request, traces_sample_rate, avg_spans_per_trace. We'll include outputs: metrics/min, spans/min, rough ingest cost.
rana: Small technical caveat: For MIG partitions, collector must preserve device.partition_id as a resource-level attribute otherwise DD UX can't correlate metrics to traces easily. Add note to runbook.
daria: Timeline: bundle draft by next Tue. Validation in staging Wed/Thu. Ops will schedule partner preview next Fri.
ops-bot: Reminder set for staging validation window: 2712392400 (next Thu 9am PT).
